en: The Dyad on Having an Object (Saraṇaduka), and the Triad on the Trainee (Sekkhattika).

Dependent on a state that is without conflict (*araṇa*) and in training (*sekkha*), a state that is not without conflict and not in training arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). [There is] one [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is without conflict and beyond training (*asekkha*), a state that is not without conflict and not beyond training arises by way of the root condition. [There is] one under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is without conflict and neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training, a state that is not without conflict and neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training arises by way of the root condition. [There is] one under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.
